title: Roll back a release
caption: deploy/scripts/deploy.sh --rollback. Migrations are not reversed (expand-only, N-1 compatible).

steps.title: Decide
steps.body: A deploy finished but the app misbehaves (an automatic rollback already happened if a unit failed its health check: the run then failed with `rolled back to <sha>`).
steps.expect: You know the sha that is current: `sudo velexis-deploy --status`.

steps.title: Roll back
steps.expect: If a variable of the previous release's templates is missing or at CHANGE_ME: `rollback to <sha> refused: ...`, nothing changed (add it, run again). Otherwise log `ROLLBACK to <previous sha>`; units, drop-in, Caddyfile, WAF files and Caddy build re-installed from the previous snapshot; units restarted and healthy.

steps.title: Fix forward
steps.body: Commit the fix and deploy again; a second `--rollback` would toggle back to the newer release.
